# 4LPK — KRAS apo bundled test target

PDB ID **4LPK** — KRAS-G12C in the apo state with Switch II in the **CLOSED** conformation
(no inhibitor in the structure). This is the canonical PRISM-TWIN end-to-end smoke test:
the engine should blind-recover the **Switch II Pocket (SII-P)** — the canonical
sotorasib binding site — at quality **Rank 1** without ever seeing an inhibitor.

## Files

| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `4lpk_raw.pdb` | RCSB | Raw download — chain A only |
| `4lpk_clean.pdb` | `prism-clean.py 4lpk_raw.pdb 4lpk_clean.pdb A` | Cleaned single-chain PDB |
| `4lpk_clean.topology.json` | `prism-prep 4lpk_clean.pdb 4lpk_clean.topology.json` | Engine input — bonds, charges, AMBER params |
| `4lpk_clean.residue_map.json` | Generated by prep | PDB ↔ topology residue ID translation |

## Why this is bundled

`*.pdb` and other structure files are gitignored at workspace level. The
`!vendor/test_targets/**` exception in `.gitignore` lets these specific files
through so fresh clones can reproduce the validated TWIN result.

## Expected result

```
scripts/prism-validate-and-run.sh \
    -t vendor/test_targets/4lpk/4lpk_clean.topology.json \
    -o output/4lpk_smoke \
    --fast --hysteresis --multi-stream 8 \
    --spike-percentile 95 --prism-therm \
    --fused-steps 4 --hmr --adaptive-dt \
    --replica-seed 42 --multi-differential -v
```

Validation gates (verified 2026-04-10):
- Phase encoding: ~95% non-zero phase_bits
- CUDA Graph capture: all 8 streams ✓
- Spatial hash join: ~31M spikes → 5 sites in <1s
- Interferometric mask: ~23/151 residues passing top-15%
- **Rank 1 (V3 composite)**: id=2, centroid (22.39, 0.24, −27.74), q≈0.318
- **Lining residues at Rank 1**: must include 68, 71, 101, 102, 103 (Switch II + α3) AND 13, 14, 15 (P-loop)

If Rank 1's lining residues don't contain all 8 of those signature residues, the
clone is **NOT** in a known-good state — investigate the PTX bundle, Director
kernel load, or build profile.
